goal: Build non-GUI Linux release binaries as static position-independent executables
Allow binaries to run on non-glibc systems and older glibc installs
Unblock security hardening like pointer authentication on aarch64
agreement: Broad support and successful testing across Alpine, NixOS, and Ubuntu (dergoegge, hebasto, 0xB10C, theStack)
Unaddressed objection: static glibc breaks mismatched host NSS resolvers, no author reply (luke-jr)
Prefers static glibc over musl as more auditable and palatable (theuni)
Questions whether fortify checks should be skipped for static binaries (willcl-ark)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it substantially expands Linux portability for release binaries
Enables execution on Alpine, NixOS, and older systems without custom shims
Unblocks security hardening features like aarch64 pointer authentication
